searchText: EIPIP Meeting 46 Agenda - https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/98 (starting in ~20 mins ) Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82357016731?pwd=V0hLUWIvU2V2UTdUd216WHdGNFBKUT09 Meeting ID: 823 5701 6731 Passcode: 885372 EIPIP meeting starting now! <@543900561460822016> 😆 (at last comment in chat) So true... so true. Heroes don't get days off, and *someone* needs to correct people on the internet on holidays. Otherwise we just have chaos. Separately, I'm dubious to your claim that there is no way to gift a repository to another organization. Is someone looking into disabling the FEM edit timer? I lost audio during that discussion. cc <@642887713246150666> I will check with the FEM team if that's possible. Just a reminder, it would be good to have a PR to move the *EIP-4345: Difficulty Bomb Delay to June 2022* to Final. <@!552133098075193354> I can tell you with certainty that it’s not possible to gift repos to orgs Even when the recipient colludes with you (accepts the gift or requests it)? The transfering user must be able to create repos in the org I could transfer it to one of those people if that’s easier Ah, so you could transfer to another user and then that user can transfer to the organization (assuming the receiving user is an org member)? Will do now! https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4569
